## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. For incidents, include the public briefing and research question.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm scenario:validate`
- [ ] `pnpm runs:verify` when changing recordings, rules, or scenarios
- [ ] Browser replay checked when changing visuals

## Research and assets

Document any changes to evaluator identity, recording compatibility, observation visibility, or third-party assets. Include no provider credentials or unreviewed live-run artifacts.
